mann-whitney-u-test.pseudocode:
def ranks_with_ties(values):  # 동점은 평균 순위
    n = len(values)
    order = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: values[i])
    ranks = [0.0] * n
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j, v = i, values[order[i]]
        while j + 1 < n and values[order[j + 1]] == v:
            j += 1
        for t in range(i, j + 1):
            ranks[order[t]] = (i + j) / 2 + 1
        i = j + 1
    return ranks

def mann_whitney_u(a, b):
    r = ranks_with_ties(a + b)  # 두 표본 합쳐 순위
    n1, n2 = len(a), len(b)
    u1 = sum(r[:n1]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2
    return min(u1, n1 * n2 - u1)  # 임계값·정규근사로 판정

market-basket-analysis.pseudocode:
def rule_metrics(transactions, a, b):  # 규칙 a → b
    n = len(transactions)
    n_a = sum(1 for t in transactions if a in t)
    n_b = sum(1 for t in transactions if b in t)
    n_ab = sum(1 for t in transactions if a in t and b in t)
    support = n_ab / n
    confidence = n_ab / n_a  # P(b | a)
    lift = confidence / (n_b / n)  # 1 초과: 양의 연관
    return support, confidence, lift

def mine_pairs(transactions, min_sup, min_conf):
    items = set().union(*transactions)
    rules = []
    for a in items:
        for b in items:
            if a == b:
                continue
            s, c, l = rule_metrics(transactions, a, b)
            if s >= min_sup and c >= min_conf:
                rules.append((a, b, s, c, l))
    return rules

markov-chain.pseudocode:
def stationary(P, iters=1000, tol=1e-12):
    # P[i][j]: 상태 i → j 전이확률(행 합 = 1)
    n = len(P)
    pi = [1.0 / n] * n  # 균등 분포에서 시작
    for _ in range(iters):
        nxt = [sum(pi[i] * P[i][j] for i in range(n))
               for j in range(n)]  # π ← πP
        if max(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(pi, nxt)) < tol:
            return nxt
        pi = nxt
    return pi  # 정상 분포 π = πP

matchmaking.pseudocode:
def expected(ra, rb):  # A의 기대 승률
    return 1 / (1 + 10 ** ((rb - ra) / 400))

def elo_update(ra, rb, score_a, k=32):  # 승1·무0.5·패0
    ea = expected(ra, rb)
    ra_new = ra + k * (score_a - ea)
    rb_new = rb + k * ((1 - score_a) - (1 - ea))
    return ra_new, rb_new  # 두 변화량 합은 0

def can_match(p, q, wait_sec):
    tol = 50 + 10 * wait_sec  # 오래 기다릴수록 범위 확대
    same_region = p.region == q.region
    return same_region and abs(p.mmr - q.mmr) <= tol

material-requirements-planning.pseudocode:
def mrp(gross, on_hand, receipts, lead_time, lot=1):
    # gross[t]: 기간별 총소요량, receipts[t]: 예정 입고
    T = len(gross)
    releases = [0] * T  # 기간별 계획 발주량
    stock = on_hand
    for t in range(T):
        stock += receipts[t]
        net = gross[t] - stock  # 순소요량
        if net > 0:
            qty = -(-net // lot) * lot  # 로트 단위 올림
            start = max(t - lead_time, 0)  # 리드타임 역산
            releases[start] += qty  # 0 미만이면 긴급 발주
            stock += qty  # 계획 입고 반영
        stock -= gross[t]
    return releases

max-heap.pseudocode:
def push(h, key):  # h[0]은 미사용(1-base)
    h.append(key)
    i = len(h) - 1
    while i > 1 and h[i // 2] < h[i]:  # 부모보다 크면
        h[i // 2], h[i] = h[i], h[i // 2]  # 상향 이동
        i //= 2

def pop_max(h):  # O(log n)
    top = h[1]
    h[1] = h[-1]  # 마지막 원소를 루트로
    h.pop()
    i, n = 1, len(h) - 1
    while 2 * i <= n:
        c = 2 * i  # 왼쪽 자식
        if c + 1 <= n and h[c + 1] > h[c]:
            c += 1  # 더 큰 자식 선택
        if h[i] >= h[c]:
            break
        h[i], h[c] = h[c], h[i]  # 하향 이동
        i = c
    return top

max-min-fairness.pseudocode:
def max_min_fair(capacity, demands):
    alloc = {u: 0.0 for u in demands}
    active = set(demands)  # 아직 할당 안 된 사용자
    remain = capacity
    while active:
        share = remain / len(active)  # 균등 몫
        done = {u for u in active if demands[u] <= share}
        if not done:  # 전원 요구가 몫보다 큼
            for u in active:
                alloc[u] = share
            break
        for u in done:  # 요구 이하 사용자는 완전 충족
            alloc[u] = demands[u]
            remain -= demands[u]
        active -= done  # 잉여는 다음 반복에서 재분배
    return alloc
